name: Default
shortDescription: Performance dashboard for an existing PostgreSQL database: slow and live queries, unused and suggested indexes, space usage and connections, behind HTTP basic auth.

alerts.message: PgHero does not include a database. Set DATABASE_URL to the PostgreSQL server you want to monitor (URL-encode special characters in the user or password); it must be reachable from this deployment. The dashboard is protected by HTTP basic auth with the user admin and the generated PGHERO_PASSWORD.
